_meta.source: starfi5h/AlchemyFactoryCalculator develop branch, js/alchemy_calc_engine.js (DB v55, gameVersion 1.0.4950)
_meta.note: These are the five production-affecting upgrade tracks modeled by the community calculator, with formulas extracted verbatim from its engine code (unchanged between DB v41 and v55). 1.0 reworked shop sales upgrades and removed purchase-contract upgrades (folded into Shop Recognition); no authoritative datamined skill-tree dump exists yet. Verified against the upstream engine 2026-09-12.

tracks.name: Logistics Efficiency (Belt Speed)
tracks.note: Same curve as Factory Efficiency scaled by 60: at equal Logistics and Factory levels one belt carries exactly 60 * speedMult, so machines per full belt never change. Level the two together to keep blueprints stable.

tracks.name: Factory Efficiency (Machine Speed)
tracks.affects: all machine crafting speed (divides recipe baseTime) and Nursery crop growth (verified in-game), except the Seed Plot; also multiplies machine heat consumption per second (net heat per batch unchanged)

tracks.name: Alchemy Skill (Batch Yield)
tracks.affects: batch yield multiplier, ONLY for: Extractor, Thermal Extractor, Alembic, Advanced Alembic. Thermal Extractor additionally gets a fixed 3x yield on top of this multiplier.
tracks.formula: alchemyMult(lvl) = 1.0 + sum_{i=1..lvl}(p_i)/100 where p_i = 6 for i<=2, 8 for 3<=i<=8, 10 for i>=9

tracks.name: Fuel Efficiency
tracks.affects: heat energy extracted per fuel item burned

tracks.name: Fertilizer Efficiency
tracks.affects: nutrient value extracted per fertilizer item consumed

notModeled: Shop sales upgrade: sellMult(lvl) = 1 + 0.01 * lvl (upstream engine getSellMult; affects sale price, not production)
